title: Generic PCR Prep Part 2 - Mastermix and DNA Distribution
author: Opentrons
materials: Master Mix Distribution and DNA Transfer](./generic_pcr_prep_
The protocol distributes mastermix to the destination plate
The samples are mixed by pipetting

steps.title: Load robot and consumables
steps.instruction: Mount the selected pipette(s) on the OT‑2, load tip racks in the indicated deck slots, place the master‑mix reservoir (or deep‑well plate) with the mix in well A1, position the DNA source plate(s) and the destination plate on the deck (optionally on temperature modules), and verify that the combined volume range of the pipette(s) includes the smallest volume to be transferred.

substeps.instruction: If using one pipette, load tip racks in slots 4, 5, 7, 8, and 10.
If using two pipettes, load tip racks for the left pipette in slots 4, 7, and 10, and for the right pipette in slots 5 and 8.
Place the master‑mix reservoir (or deep‑well plate) so that well A1 contains the master mix.
Place DNA template plate(s) and the destination plate on the deck; optionally set temperature modules for each plate.

steps.title: Distribute master mix
steps.instruction: Aspirate master mix from well A1 of the reservoir/deep‑well plate and dispense it into the destination plate wells according to the ‘Number of samples’ parameter, which determines how many columns of the destination plate receive master mix.

substeps.instruction: Select single‑ or multi‑channel pipette as appropriate; ensure the pipette’s minimum volume can handle the smallest dispense volume.
For each column up to the specified Number of samples, dispense the programmed master‑mix volume into the corresponding wells of the destination plate.

steps.title: Transfer DNA templates
steps.instruction: Move DNA template samples from the source plate(s) to the destination plate, following the chosen transfer mode (96‑well to 96‑well or up to four 96‑well plates to a 384‑well plate) and the appropriate column/row mapping.

substeps.instruction: If transferring a single 96‑well source to a 96‑well destination, transfer each column directly to the matching column of the destination plate.

If transferring up to four 96‑well plates to a 384‑well plate with a multi‑channel pipette, intercalate columns: column 1 of the 96‑well plate goes to the odd rows of column 1 of the 384‑well plate, column 2 goes to the even rows of column 1, column 3 to odd rows of column 2, column 4 to even rows of column 2, and so on.
If using a single‑channel pipette for 96‑to‑384 transfer, move DNA sequentially well‑by‑well from the 96‑well plates to the appropriate wells of the 384‑well plate.

steps.title: Mix samples by pipetting
steps.instruction: Mix each well by aspirating and dispensing the combined master mix and DNA template the number of times specified by the ‘Number of mixes’ parameter.

substeps.instruction: For each destination well, perform the programmed number of mix cycles using the same pipette that delivered the DNA.
